The '''Outpost''' is an old, now-derelict tower to the north of [[West Ardougne]] where [[Jorral]] can be found, and is involved heavily in the [[Making History]] quest, which centres around the tower. The Outpost, though now disused, played a very important role in the history of [[Kandarin]] and the [[Ardignas family|Ardignas line]] of royalty.

==Transportation==
The Outpost lies just off the north-west corner of [[West Ardougne]], and can be reached in a variety of ways.

'''Note''': Many of the fast transport methods require the start or completion of various [[quests]] before they can be used.
*[[Necklace of passage]]
*[[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] locations:
**[[Spirit tree]]
**[[Balloon transport system]]
**[[Gnome glider]]
**[[Stronghold Slayer Cave]] teleport on the [[Slayer ring]]
*[[Games necklace]] to [[Barbarian Outpost]], take [[Rocks (Tree Gnome Stronghold)|the level 37 Agility shortcut]]
*Teleports to the [[Ardougne]] area. From [[East Ardougne]], players must walk north-west to exit the city and then west to the Outpost.
**[[Ardougne Teleport]].
**[[Spirit tree]] to the [[Battlefield|Battlefield of Khazard]].
*[[Eagle transport system]] to [[Eagles' Peak (mountain)|Eagles' Peak]], then climbing down the eastern side of the mountain.
*[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AKQ}} to the [[Piscatoris Hunter area]], then walking east to use [[Kathy Corkat]]'s rowboat to the southern part of the hunter area.

==History==
===Foundation===
Established in the year 30 of the [[Fifth Age]],{{CiteText|text=Scroll (Making History)|quote=Timeline of the Ardougne Outpost: Start of Fifth age: Outpost built + 65 Years: 'The Dreaded Years of Tragedy' + 68 Years: 'The Great Battle'|notes= [[The Great Battle]] occurred in the year 98. Therefore, the Outpost was likely built in the year 30.}} the Outpost was constructed to serve simple watchtower to guard the city of Ardougne from invading armies.{{CiteNPC|npc=Narrator|quote=With many occupants over the years... ...the building has seen much action. It started life as an outpost... ... its sole purpose being to see invading armies... ... before they saw the city of Ardougne.|loc=Making History|notes=|name=}}

It was not until year 95 of the Fifth Age that the Outpost was put to important use. 65 years after its construction, a group of followers of [[Zamorak]], a religion which was becoming popular in Kandarin, moved into the Outpost and began to cause trouble around Ardougne, in the period now known as "[[The Dreaded Years of Tragedy]]" in history books, in which the Zamorakians carried out various mischief such as turning all the children in Ardougne invisible and letting them cause chaos. Three years later, Saradominists launched a crusade to defeat the Zamorakians.{{CiteText|text=Journal (Making History)|author=Drozal}} 

===The Great Battle===
After several years of chaos in Ardougne, the authorities there called for help, and an army of [[Saradomin]]ists, led by the former friend of the Zamorakian leader, met with the Zamorakians and fought what later became known as The Great Battle, a battle which led to the deaths of everyone present, with the exception of the two leaders, the Saradominist and the Zamorakian, both being the most powerful [[mage]]s.{{CiteText|text=The History of the Outpost|quote=The battle produced two survivors - the two ex- friends, both being the most powerful mages.|page=7}} After seeing all the bloodshed they had caused, the two put aside their differences and both converted to [[Guthix]]ianism, following the teaches of the [[god]] of balance, Guthix. Later the two set about helping the steadily growing city of Ardougne, one of the two becoming the King, who ruled fairly and leniently.{{CiteText|text=The History of the Outpost|quote=Settling for the neutral god Guthix, the two went about their ways to spread equality among the people. One of the friends became king, to listen to people's views and ensure a fair and equal life for everyone, whilst the other friend founded the market place, allowing people to trade their skills and wares under equal rights and opportunities.|page=8}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Jorral|quote=We know that one of these friends became King, and was the Great Grandfather of the current king, and that the other established the market place.}} 

===Aftermath===
The King that rose from the inconclusive Great Battle was the first in the line of [[Ardignas family|Ardignas]]. While his name is not recorded, he is father of [[King Narras]], grand-father of [[King Ulthas]], and great-grandfather of [[King Lathas]] and [[King Tyras]], who still rule Ardougne, which has now been split into two parts, East and West.

In [[Making History]], the player encounters a few figures involved with the outpost. A couple surviving descendants of a man who died there reside in East Ardougne: [[Silver Merchant|Erin the Silver Merchant]] and his mother, though neither know much at all about him or his involvement in the conflict except that the [[enchanted key]] Erin possessed belonged to him, which he will pass on to the player. There is also the ghost [[Droalak]] in [[Port Phasmatys]] who left for the outpost (for reasons unspecified), but is reluctant to talk about the experience except that he died there. He possesses knowledge of key events concerning the outpost and writes their dates on the [[scroll_(Making_History)|scroll]] that he hands off to the player in [[Making History]]. He also presumably knows of [[Jorral]] as he names him without the player having done so.

==Features==
[[File:Enchanted key detail.png|100px|right]]
Following the completion of the Making History quest, the Outpost is the location of a small Museum, which houses several oddities and artefacts as well as several books on the History of the Outpost itself, the modern-day history of Ardougne and the [[Ardignas family|Ardignas line]], and a book on "[[The Mysterious Adventurer]]", which is a tale told about the [[player]] themselves.

Several important items are exhibited in [[large displays]] in the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the outpost, consisting of a [[helmet]] supposedly worn by [[Wally]], a hero in the history of [[Varrock]] who slew the [[demon]] [[Delrith]] with the sword [[Silverlight]], a [[battleaxe]] wielded by [[Arrav]] before his quest to find a [[Shield of Arrav|magical shield]] to save Avarrocka from Zemouregal, a [[Mahjarrat]], and last walking [[boots]] which were worn by [[Randas]], a famous explorer who was known to have braved the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] only to be corrupted by Zamorak and turned into a [[Soulless]].

There is also a [[Fremennik shield|large, wooden shield]] in a glass case akin to those used by the [[Fremennik]], nomadic people who are the closest link to the [[Fourth Age]] there currently is, and an [[Iron mace]] which serves as an early example of [[smithing]] weaponry, and two flags: one bearing the Star of Saradomin, and the other the symbol of Zamorak. On the roof of the outpost there lies a dilapidated and rotten catapult.

==Personalities and monsters==
*[[Jorral]], a historian whose plight is to save the historically important Outpost from being torn down by Lathas. He begins the Making History [[quest]].
*The Outpost is surrounded by several creatures and monsters which could pose a danger to lower-levelled players, such as [[grizzly bear]]s, [[wolves]], and [[hobgoblin]]s. Also, further north, close to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, there are groups of [[gnome]]s and [[Warrior (Thieving)|warriors]] dotted around the forest.

==Quests==
One quest can be started in the Outpost, one of which is heavily centred around the building.
*[[Making History]], in which the player pieces together the history of the Outpost to save it from being demolished and turns it into a museum.
*If [[Making History]] is completed before initiating the quest [[Tower of Life]], it is revealed by [[Effigy]] that the Outpost was supposed to be their new alchemy lab. Unfortunately (due to a pesky adventurer) the plan was spoiled when the Outpost became a museum.

==Trivia==
* The [[large display]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the Outpost states the battleaxe on display was wielded by [[Arrav]], who supposedly left it behind by accident before going to find the [[Shield of Arrav (item)|legendary shield]]. However, Arrav can be seen wielding [[Arrav's axe|his axe]] when encountered during [[Defender of Varrock]] and [[The Curse of Arrav]]. Due to the differences in the designs of each axe (with the one Arrav wielding notably having three blue stripes on its handle), it is possible the axe in possession of the Outpost is a fake.
* The [[large display]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Outpost incorrectly states that the battle occurred 68 years after the start of the Fifth Age rather than 68 years after the construction of the Outpost.
